title: Metadata-driven static-latency reporting
summary: Improved existing design reports by replacing hardcoded cases with Configuration Engine metadata.

dates.note: First inspected milestone: 2024-10-11. See facts for earlier/later feature stages; this is neither proof of first-ever work nor a formal role/leadership start or shipped release date.

facts.text: Corrected static-latency reporting across instance types, wire modes, retiming settings and SERDES.
Refactored an existing static-latency report from extensive hardcoded logic toward Configuration Engine metadata and API information.
Exposed default-latency attributes through the engine API and replaced extensive report-specific conditionals with metadata-backed minimum/configured latency handling.

The historical standalone resource script was pruned in March 2026, while an active CE static-latency report still reads DefaultLatency and retiming metadata; resource cleanup did not remove the entire reporting capability.

notes: 2026-10-27 local Git/source research supplements prior evidence. Authorship supports attributable implementation; shared components and later colleague changes retain separate ownership. No employer tests were rerun.
A standalone resource entry was pruned by a colleague; active reporting remains under CE. Hardware latency defaults include supplied values credited to another engineer.
